newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Pertamina to shut one Cilacap CDU for maintenance.
newsitem.headline: Pertamina to shut one Cilacap CDU for maintenance.

text.p: Indonesia's state oil company Pertamina plans to shut its 100,000 barrels per day (bpd) capacity crude distillation unit (CDU) at the Cilacap refinery for maintenance from August 13, a company source said on Tuesday.
"We plan to shut the 100,000 bpd capacity of CDU from August 13 for about 35 days for maintenance. The other 200,000 bpd CDU will remain in operation," the source said.
He said the 100,000 bpd CDU at Cilacap processed crude from the Middle East.
Pertamina has two refineries in one complex at Cilacap with a combined capacity of 300,000 bpd.
